description: This PHP source file defines the configuration class 'LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration' for the LDAP authentication plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It handles initialization of LDAP logging and authentication setup, registration of LDAP synchronization commands, and scheduling of periodic LDAP sync tasks.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the LDAP Authentication plugin, implementing plugin setup, command registration, and scheduling

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up LDAP logging and adds LDAP provider to the auth chain if LDAP is enabled

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers LDAP synchronization command for console execution

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules LDAP user synchronization at a specified interval if LDAP is enabled
